nagardhan.title: File:Entrance to Nagardhan Fort 2.jpg
nagardhan.description: Nagardhan Fort is a historic fort located near Ramtek in the Nagpur district of Maharashtra, India. Built during the 18th century by the Bhonsle dynasty, it served as an important military and administrative center for the Nagpur kingdom. The fort has a rectangular structure with fortified walls, a prominent gateway, and a deep moat for defense. Inside, there are remnants of palaces, courtyards, and water reservoirs.
